roundSetup.deal: random, backend-authoritative, one Starting Card per occupied seat

dice.d6: Itchy activation, Hunter conversion, Bandit Raider tie break only
dice.multiWakeDuplicates: reroll only the duplicate until that player's wake results are unique

allegiancePrecedence: Trouble In On It or Hunter conversion remains Bandit-side
otherwise Bandit Current Card = Bandit-side; non-Bandit Current Card = Business-side

rolesV3.Dooker: 3 distinct wakes; second Glimpse reads current allegiance at that timestamp; third views one Hammock card and may Trip it onto one player without seeing displaced card
rolesV3.Itchy: d6 5–6 activates second distinct wake and post-theft two-player historical-Raider clue with one legal non-Raider decoy when possible; if a legal pair cannot be formed, the clue is explicitly marked degraded rather than masquerading as a normal pair
rolesV3.Trouble: blind swap two distinct other Current Cards; theft-window overlap converts before swap and reveals historical Raider identity to Trouble
rolesV3.Business: if genuinely alone, choose one other player and inspect exactly one randomly selected wake result, never the full schedule
rolesV3.Snuggler: bond two distinct other players; partner may be Bond-Revealed when the other is caught; Bond-Reveal is not itself a capture
rolesV3.Hunter: recognizes Guardian; two wakes; first starting-Bandit overlap triggers one d6, 1–2 converts; loyal Hunter later marks
rolesV3.Guardian: recognizes starting Hunter; never learns conversion; protects one other player by removing them from Paw Point capture eligibility

evidence.hardPersonalFact: authorized mechanical fact delivered to this player
evidence.hardHistoricalEvent: objective event, possibly hidden until replay
evidence.corroboratedClaim: independent public stories agree; still not server verification
evidence.staleFact: fact true at an earlier timestamp that may not describe dawn
evidence.socialRead: behavioral interpretation with no authoritative system weight

morningBusiness.quickRoleClaim: bluff-safe statement builder; Starting Role and Current Card claims are tracked separately and optional timeline fields are not authenticated against hidden truth
morningBusiness.claimParsing: timestamp-aware: legal multi-wake testimony and PRESENT→MISSING chronology are not flattened into contradictions; Starting Role capability checks never derive from a Current Card claim

pawPoint.guardianProtection: protected target removed from vote-capture eligibility; votes remain recorded for replay
pawPoint.ties: all eligible tied top vote-getters are caught
pawPoint.targetRule: one other active player; self-votes are illegal
pawPoint.zeroCapture: if Guardian protection removes every positive eligible vote total, Paw Point catches nobody

secondaryResolution.snuggleBond: Bond-Reveal only; not an additional Paw Point capture
secondaryResolution.hunterMark: loyal Hunter caught -> marked target caught only if Bandit-aligned at resolution; converted Hunter has no loyal mark effect
secondaryResolution.resultSemantics: caught = Paw Point or valid loyal-Hunter Hunt Mark capture; bondRevealed = results-only reveal and never capture
secondaryResolution.lateResultUpdates: frontend render caches must invalidate when authorized bondRevealed/catch provenance fields change

primaryWin.Business: historical Raider is in final valid catch set

bots.hiddenRolePrivacy: direct questions cannot force hidden-role disclosure; bots use authorized facts plus public claims only
bots.claimParsing: recognizes human Quick Role Claim phrasing and bot volunteer phrasing; public claims never grant hidden server truth
bots.itchyVoting: when a non-degraded two-player clue exists, loyal Itchy keeps its own Paw Point within the guaranteed candidate pair
bots.guardianProtection: starting-Hunter recognition is stale-capable trust, not an automatic protection command
bots.hunterMark: converted Hunter never uses loyal Hunt Mark logic
